protocol.title: A Microfluidics Approach Towards High-Throughput Pathogen Removal from Blood Using Margination
protocol.platform: Pressure-driven continuous-flow PDMS microfluidic device (straight margination channels, cascaded bifurcation design)
protocol.objective: Label-free, non-specific removal of blood-borne pathogens (bacteria and fungi) and inflammatory cellular components (platelets and leukocytes) from whole blood via RBC-driven margination in narrow microchannels, for sepsis treatment application

device.fabrication: Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS, Sylgard 184, Dow Corning); standard soft lithography; silicon wafer patterned by deep reactive ion etching (DRIE); PDMS cured 10:1 w/w prepolymer:curing agent at 70 C for 2 h; bonded to glass slides by air plasma (Harrick Plasma Cleaner); 1.5 mm inlet/outlet holes punched
device.silanization: Trichloro(1H,1H,2H,2H-perfluorooctyl)silane (Sigma Aldrich); 1 h for both silicon wafer and PDMS master template
device.channel_design: Two cascaded straight margination channels with two bifurcations (1:8:1) in series

parallel_device.filter_purpose: Remove clogs and debris upstream of margination channels

device.flow_driver: Syringe pump (NE-1000, New Era Pump Systems Inc.)
device.imaging: Inverted phase contrast microscope (Olympus IX71) + Hamamatsu C4742-80-12AG CCD camera; IPLAB software for video acquisition; ImageJ for analysis
device.confocal: LSM 510 meta laser scanning confocal (Carl Zeiss) on Axiovert 100 M; 488 nm excitation; 10x objective + 2.5x digital zoom; 1 um z-slices; 512x512 px

separation_principle.mechanism: Leukocyte margination (in vivo microcirculatory phenomenon adapted to microchannels)
separation_principle.rbc_behaviour: Deformable RBCs migrate axially to channel centre (Fahreaus effect) under Poiseuille flow profile, forming an RBC-rich core and a peripheral cell-free layer adjacent to channel walls
driving_forces: Hydrodynamic RBC-bacteria interactions at high shear
separation_principle.rbc_aggregation: Minimal at high working shear rate; margination proceeds via Fahreaus effect and hydrodynamic interactions rather than rouleaux formation
separation_principle.cascaded_benefit: Stage-2 filtered blood has higher hematocrit (+~10% post-stage-1), enhancing RBC axial migration and RBC-bacteria hydrodynamic interactions for additional margination in the second channel

reagents.whole_blood: Human whole blood (Research Blood Components, Brighton MA); used fresh for whole-blood analysis; washed for device characterisation
reagents.sample_buffer_characterisation: 1x PBS + 0.5% v/v BSA + 3% w/v Dextran-40 (Sigma Aldrich); Dextran-40 prevents cell sedimentation

ecoli.label: GFP (arabinose-inducible)
ecoli.culture: Overnight 37 C in LB Agar + ampicillin 100 ug/mL + arabinose 0.1%

ecoli_bioparticles.product: Alexa Fluor 488 E. coli K-12 BioParticles conjugates (Invitrogen)

saccharomyces.label: YFP
saccharomyces.source: Gift from Dr. Jacquin Niles, MIT Department of Biological Engineering

platelet_marker.incubation: 40 min at 4 C directly in fresh whole blood

leukocyte_marker.incubation: 40 min at 4 C directly in fresh whole blood

reagents.agar_plates: LB agar; 10 uL aliquots plated; CFU counted after 24 h at 37 C

operating_conditions.flow_rate_rationale: PDMS device and tubing connections not rigid enough to withstand pressure drop at higher flow rates for extended operation; bacteria margination efficiency plateaus above 10 uL/min

flow_rate_optimisation.bacteria_margination_onset: Negligible at 1 uL/min; improved with increasing flow rate; constant beyond 10 uL/min

aspect_ratio_optimisation.rationale: Aspect ratio 1 (20x20 um) gives isotropic shear distribution resembling circular blood vessels; efficient RBC core formation across full cross-section; highest throughput at aspect ratio <= 1

channel_length_optimisation.observation: Margination constant across all tested lengths; 5 mm selected to minimise pressure drop and allow higher working flow rate

steps.name: RBC sample preparation (device characterisation)
steps.operation: Wash 3x with PBS + 0.5% BSA; resuspend at 45% hematocrit in PBS + 0.5% BSA + 3% Dextran-40
steps.centrifugation: Abstracted as heat at 25c (no centrifuge primitive in BioScript)
steps.notes: Washing removes plasma proteins and platelets; Dextran-40 prevents RBC sedimentation during syringe pump-driven flow. For whole-blood pathogen removal experiments, unwashed fresh blood is used directly.

steps.name: Antibody staining for cellular component analysis
steps.operation: Incubate fresh whole blood with fluorophore-conjugated antibodies at 4 C for 40 min
steps.notes: No prior washing; staining performed directly in fresh blood to preserve native cell populations. Blood placed at 4 C without washing before antibody addition.

steps.name: Microbial spiking into whole blood
steps.operation: Vortex microbes into antibody-stained blood for 30 s
steps.notes: E. coli (~2 x 0.5 um rod; rigid peptidoglycan wall E' ~1e7 Pa) marginate via size difference and stiffness contrast with RBCs (E' ~1e4 Pa); rod shape confers additional tumbling/rotational motion enhancing lateral drift. S. cerevisiae (~5 um ovoid; E' ~1e8 Pa) undergo complete corner margination to all four channel walls, yielding higher removal efficiency than bacteria.

steps.name: Stage 1 margination
steps.operation: Continuous laminar flow; RBCs migrate axially to form RBC-rich core; bacteria, yeast, platelets, and leukocytes marginate radially to cell-free wall region
steps.bifurcation: 1:8:1; marginated cells collected in narrow side channels (waste); RBC-enriched blood exits large centre outlet
steps.notes: Cell-free layer enhanced at the expanded bifurcation (20 um -> 200 um width). Most marginated bacteria reside in cell-free region next to channel wall, efficiently removed by side channels. Centre outlet (ratio 8) collects densely-packed RBCs with minimal loss.

steps.name: Stage 2 margination (cascaded design)
steps.operation: Bacteria-depleted blood from stage 1 undergoes additional margination; higher hematocrit post-stage-1 amplifies Fahreaus effect and RBC-bacteria hydrodynamic interactions
steps.bifurcation: 1:8:1; second waste stream drained; final filtered blood collected from centre outlet
steps.haemolysis: Negligible; optical absorption at 414 nm; RBC transit time < 0.01 s in high-shear margination zone

steps.name: FACS analysis of filtered blood
steps.instrument: BD LSR II flow cytometer (BD Biosciences)
steps.normalisation: Bacteria/cell concentration at centre outlet / inlet sample concentration

results.rbc_recovery_increase_pct: ~30 (Fahreaus effect; 1:8:1 bifurcation packs RBCs into centre outlet)

steps.name: Bacterial CFU quantification
steps.operation: Plate 10 uL aliquots from inlet and filtered centre outlet on LB agar; count colonies after 24 h at 37 C

theoretical_separation_efficiency.basis: Ratio of wetted perimeter of centre region to total cross-section perimeter at bifurcation
theoretical_separation_efficiency.agreement: Experimental results in good agreement with theoretical values at each stage

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: Sample prep; antibody staining; microbial spiking; two-stage margination; FACS detection
